summary: @servicetitan/component-usage 28.5.2 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from a GitHub release URL, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run a bundled `math_init.js` — a ~727KB single-line Bun-compiled blob with a rotated string-array deobfuscator (WV8StW shift-rotator, large n7gIxM constant array, hc1jfK9 decoder). The blob is invoked automatically on `npm install` via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])`. The advertised functionality (a ServiceTitan component-usage / Datadog metrics library in `dist/index.js` built on dogapi and @segment/dependency-report) does not require Bun; the dropper shares no code paths or dependencies with the shipped library. The pattern — fetching a second-language runtime at preinstall specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling script — bypasses Node-based install-time scanners and is unrelated to any legitimate build step for the library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
